note: Dogfood-realistic fixture (not a private IndexedDB dump). Same schema as browser export.

echoes.userThought: 先用便宜的小模型跑一遍,把明显不行的筛掉,只把拿不准的交给贵的那个
echoes.title: 模型分级路由
echoes.triggerText: Route easy cases to a cheap model and only escalate the hard ones.

echoes.userThought: 同样的问题把结果缓存下来,别每次都重新烧一遍钱
echoes.title: 响应缓存
echoes.triggerText: Cache repeated prompts so you stop paying for the same answer twice.

echoes.userThought: 切块别按固定字数硬切,按语义边界切,召回质量高很多
echoes.title: 语义切块
echoes.triggerText: Semantic chunking beats fixed-size splitting for retrieval quality.

echoes.userThought: 关键词搜索最大的毛病是换个说法就搜不到,向量能抓住意思一样的
echoes.title: 为什么需要向量检索
echoes.triggerText: Keyword search misses paraphrases; embeddings capture meaning.

echoes.userThought: Agent 必须记住上一轮聊过什么,不然每次都从头再来,太蠢了
echoes.title: Agent 记忆
echoes.triggerText: Agents need to remember prior turns instead of starting cold each time.

echoes.userThought: 把会话状态落到库里,进程重启也不会把进度弄丢
echoes.title: 会话持久化
echoes.triggerText: Persist conversation state to a database so restarts don't lose progress.

echoes.userThought: 自己天天用才知道哪里别扭;你自己都不愿意用的功能,就是还没想清楚
echoes.title: 先自己用
echoes.triggerText: If you won't use it every day, it isn't ready to ship.

echoes.userThought: 存东西这一步只要有一丁点摩擦,人就干脆不存了
echoes.title: 零摩擦捕获
echoes.triggerText: Any friction in the capture step quietly kills the habit.

echoes.userThought: 定价先放个贵的选项当锚点,后面的就显得划算了
echoes.title: 定价锚定
echoes.triggerText: Show an expensive option first so everything else looks reasonable.

echoes.userThought: 新用户头两分钟没感觉到价值就走了,首屏必须直接给结果
echoes.title: 首次体验
echoes.triggerText: If users don't feel value in the first two minutes, they leave.

echoes.userThought: TiDB 里用 VEC_COSINE_DISTANCE 给结果按相似度排序
echoes.title: TiDB 向量查询
echoes.triggerText: Order rows by VEC_COSINE_DISTANCE in TiDB for similarity search.

echoes.userThought: 周报别写成流水账,只写卡点和要做的决策
echoes.title: 周报怎么写
echoes.triggerText: Weekly updates should list blockers and decisions, not an activity log.

echoes.userThought: 冷启动别急着投广告,先手动找到 100 个真的离不开你的用户
echoes.title: 冷启动获客
echoes.triggerText: Find 100 users who love it before you scale acquisition.

echoes.userThought: 别过早优化性能,先把能用的东西做出来再说
echoes.title: 别过早优化
echoes.triggerText: Don't optimize before you have something that actually works.

echoes.userThought: 能异步就别开会,别为了同步硬凑一个所有人都在的时间
echoes.title: 异步优先
echoes.triggerText: Prefer async over forcing everyone into a synchronous meeting.

echoes.userThought: 文档写完没人搜得到就等于白写,能被检索到才算数
echoes.title: 文档要能被搜到
echoes.triggerText: Docs nobody can find are worthless; retrievability is the whole point.

echoes.userThought: embedding 先归一化,再用余弦相似度会稳很多
echoes.title: 归一化向量
echoes.triggerText: Normalize embeddings before cosine similarity for stable results.

echoes.userThought: 提示词里直接给几个例子,比长篇讲规则管用多了
echoes.title: 少样本示例
echoes.triggerText: A few concrete examples in the prompt beat a long list of rules.

echoes.userThought: 用户不会为了整理 AI 对话专门打开另一个本地 App,入口必须长在已有工作流里
echoes.title: Collect 被推翻的原因
echoes.triggerText: People will not open a separate desktop app just to manage chat snippets.

echoes.userThought: 侧边栏常驻比独立工具重要:捕获和浮现都要零启动
echoes.title: 转向浏览器 Side Panel
echoes.triggerText: Keep capture and resurfacing inside the browser side panel the user already has open.

echoes.userThought: 宁可沉默也不要用泛词把十几个弱匹配推到脸上
echoes.title: 精度优先于召回
echoes.triggerText: Prefer silence over surfacing a pile of weak single-token matches.

echoes.userThought: Probe 报告要能解释为什么接受或拒绝,不能只丢一个神秘分数
echoes.title: 可解释召回
echoes.triggerText: Every accept/reject needs an explainable ledger, not a black-box confidence.

echoes.userThought: 单词匹配一律不浮现;至少要有连续短语或三个有效词
echoes.title: Precision-first gate
echoes.triggerText: Single-token lexical hits never surface; require a phrase or three solid terms.

echoes.userThought: 动态 DOM 和虚拟列表下,锚点要用原生 ID + 指纹 + 邻居消歧 + 失败回退
echoes.title: Anchor v2
echoes.triggerText: Locate messages with native ids, SHA-256 fingerprints, neighbor disambiguation, and fallbacks.

echoes.userThought: MV3 Service Worker 会睡死,补想法要先入 chrome.storage 队列再写 Dexie
echoes.title: 写入竞态恢复
echoes.triggerText: Queue pending thought writes in chrome.storage.local before Dexie commits.

echoes.userThought: 记忆层不是 Agent:不要自动替用户做决定,人必须确认
echoes.title: 人在回路
echoes.triggerText: A memory layer should resurface candidates; humans confirm what to use.

echoes.userThought: 本地优先:默认不上传对话,导出才是用户主动带走数据
echoes.title: Local-first 隐私
echoes.triggerText: Keep Echoes in IndexedDB by default; export is the only intentional leave-device path.

echoes.userThought: 相关但时机不对,不能当成内容不相关;反馈要拆 wrong_time
echoes.title: 区分时机与相关性
echoes.triggerText: Wrong timing is not the same as irrelevant content; keep those feedback signals separate.

echoes.userThought: 向量相似度挤在一起时,不能拿绝对 cosine 当置信度
echoes.title: 相似度拥挤
echoes.triggerText: When top-k cosine scores cluster tightly, absolute similarity is not confidence.

echoes.userThought: Hybrid 应该是词法候选并上语义候选,再 precision-first 重排,而不是直接替换 BM25
echoes.title: Hybrid 不是替换
echoes.triggerText: Hybrid means union then gated rerank, not dropping lexical recall wholesale.

echoes.userThought: 评测先有 golden set,再谈换 embedding 或上 reranker
echoes.title: 先评测再调模型
echoes.triggerText: Build a labeled recall set before swapping embedding models or adding rerankers.

echoes.userThought: 面试叙事要讲清:我如何用 1493 个候选诊断推翻第一版召回
echoes.title: 用诊断数据推翻算法
echoes.triggerText: Show how probe ledgers and failure counts drove the precision-first redesign.

echoes.userThought: 实用、这个、快速这类泛词在中文里会制造大量误匹配
echoes.title: 中文泛词陷阱
echoes.triggerText: Generic Chinese tokens create false positives if single-token matches can surface.

echoes.userThought: 备份导入导出按 id upsert,狗粮迁移和重装扩展才不怕丢数据
echoes.title: 备份恢复
echoes.triggerText: Backup/import should upsert by id so reinstalls and forks do not lose Echoes.

echoes.userThought: Chrome 扩展路径改了会换 ID,IndexedDB 不会跟着走;用 junction 或备份导入
echoes.title: 扩展 ID 与数据绑定
echoes.triggerText: Unpacked extension path changes change the extension id and orphan IndexedDB.

echoes.userThought: 不要为了简历临时搭一个没有用户的云后端
echoes.title: 不做假后端
echoes.triggerText: A fake multi-tenant backend built only for resumes is negative signal.

echoes.userThought: 失败案例比平均分更有说服力:挑出误浮现和漏召回各讲清楚
echoes.title: 失败案例叙事
echoes.triggerText: Interviewers trust concrete false-positive and false-negative stories over averages alone.

echoes.userThought: LLM 页面标题会变,捕获时要解析真实会话标题而不是 tab 默认名
echoes.title: 标题解析
echoes.triggerText: Resolve the real conversation title instead of trusting a generic browser tab name.

echoes.userThought: 内容脚本在扩展 reload 后会过期,用户需要刷新 LLM 标签页
echoes.title: Content script 过期
echoes.triggerText: After extension reload, content scripts on open tabs go stale until refresh.

echoes.userThought: 搜索是本地过滤已加载数组,暂时不需要单独的全文索引
echoes.title: 本地搜索策略
echoes.triggerText: Client-side filter over the loaded Echo array is enough at dogfood scale.

echoes.userThought: 被推翻的想法要能标记,否则旧结论会在新语境里继续误导
echoes.title: 过期想法治理
echoes.triggerText: Superseded ideas need status so resurfacing does not revive dead conclusions.

echoes.userThought: 多模型对照时记录分歧,不要假装只有一个正确答案
echoes.title: 多模型分歧
echoes.triggerText: When models disagree, capture the disagreement instead of forcing a single answer.

echoes.userThought: 成本看板要分冷启动和热运行,否则 embedding 模型下载会污染延迟数字
echoes.title: 冷热延迟分开报
echoes.triggerText: Report cold-start and warm latency separately for embedding pipelines.

echoes.userThought: 威胁模型一页就够:扩展可读范围、临时选区、导出内容、第三方 API 边界
echoes.title: 轻量威胁模型
echoes.triggerText: A one-page threat model covering page access, selection, export, and third-party APIs is enough.

echoes.userThought: 实用工具清单可以很长,但那不等于我现在要做这些功能
echoes.title: 泛词噪声样本
echoes.triggerText: A long list of practical tips is not a commitment to build every tip.

echoes.userThought: 这个方案看起来很快,但快速落地不等于解决了误打扰
echoes.title: 快速≠正确
echoes.triggerText: Shipping fast is not the same as fixing false resurfacing.

echoes.userThought: 咖啡豆烘焙曲线和产品路线图无关,只是偶然聊到的兴趣
echoes.title: 无关兴趣噪声
echoes.triggerText: Coffee roasting curves are an unrelated hobby chat, not product memory.

echoes.userThought: 健身房卧推计划本周完成三次,跟 AI 记忆产品无关
echoes.title: 生活噪声
echoes.triggerText: Gym schedule notes should never resurface during LLM engineering work.

echoes.userThought: 旧假设:独立 Collect 桌面端是正确入口——已推翻,勿再当正例
echoes.title: 已推翻的 Collect 假设
echoes.triggerText: Deprecated hypothesis: a standalone Collect desktop app is the right entry point.

echoes.userThought: 旧假设:把所有 AI 原文全文存下来以后总能搜到——已推翻
echoes.title: 已推翻的全文囤积
echoes.triggerText: Deprecated hypothesis: store entire AI transcripts and search later.

echoes.userThought: Reranker 可以晚一点上,先证明 hybrid 候选生成是否值得
echoes.title: Rerank 排期
echoes.triggerText: Prove hybrid candidate generation before investing in a cross-encoder reranker.

echoes.userThought: Trace 默认本地可导出,不要为了 observability 强行上云监控
echoes.title: 本地可观测性
echoes.triggerText: Local-first products can prove observability with exportable traces, not cloud APM.

echoes.userThought: 英文 paraphrase 测试: cheap model first, escalate only uncertain cases
echoes.title: Bilingual routing note
echoes.triggerText: Keep a bilingual twin of the routing idea for mixed-language selections.

echoes.userThought: 同词异义:苹果公司财报 versus 苹果派食谱,检索必须靠上下文消歧
echoes.title: 同词异义消歧
echoes.triggerText: The token apple needs context to decide between company filings and pie recipes.

echoes.userThought: 周末想做苹果派,黄油要提前从冰箱拿出来软化
echoes.title: 苹果派食谱
echoes.triggerText: Take the butter out early so it softens before you make apple pie.
